type NestedObjectInfer<T> = T extends infer U extends { a: infer V } ? V : 'no';
const nestedObjectNumber: NestedObjectInfer<{ a: number }> = 1;
const nestedObjectString: NestedObjectInfer<{ a: number }> = 'word';
const nestedObjectMissing: NestedObjectInfer<{ b: number }> = 'no';
type NestedArrayInfer<T> = T extends infer U extends Array<infer V> ? V : 'no';
const nestedArrayNumber: NestedArrayInfer<number[]> = 2;
const nestedArrayString: NestedArrayInfer<number[]> = 'array';
type NestedTupleInfer<T> = T extends infer U extends [infer V] ? V : 'no';
const nestedTupleString: NestedTupleInfer<[number]> = 'tuple';
type NestedMethodInfer<T> = T extends infer U extends { f(): infer V } ? V : 'no';
const nestedMethodString: NestedMethodInfer<{ f(): number }> = 'method';
type NestedUnionInfer<T> = T extends infer U extends { a: number } | { b: infer V } ? V : 'no';
const nestedUnionNumber: NestedUnionInfer<{ b: number }> = 3;
const nestedUnionString: NestedUnionInfer<{ a: number }> = 'union';
type NestedBoundInfer<T> = T extends infer U extends { a: infer V extends string } ? V : 'no';
const nestedBound: NestedBoundInfer<{ a: 'literal' }> = 'string';
const nestedBoundMissing: NestedBoundInfer<{ a: number }> = 'no';
type DeepNestedInfer<T> = T extends infer U extends { a: infer V extends Array<infer W extends string> } ? [V, W] : 'no';
const deepNested: DeepNestedInfer<{ a: ['literal'] }> = [['first', 'second'], 'third'];
const deepNestedMissing: DeepNestedInfer<{ a: number[] }> = 'no';
type NestedParameterInfer<T> = T extends infer U extends ((x: infer V) => void) ? V : 'no';
const nestedParameter: NestedParameterInfer<(x: number) => void> = 'no';
type TupleNestedInfer<T, C> = T extends [infer U extends C, infer V extends { a: infer W }] ? W : 'no';
const tupleNested: TupleNestedInfer<[1, { a: number }], number> = 'tuple';
const tupleNestedMissing: TupleNestedInfer<['a', { a: number }], number> = 'no';
console.log(nestedObjectNumber, nestedObjectString, nestedObjectMissing, nestedArrayNumber, nestedArrayString);
console.log(nestedTupleString, nestedMethodString, nestedUnionNumber, nestedUnionString, nestedBound, nestedBoundMissing);
console.log(deepNested, deepNestedMissing, nestedParameter, tupleNested, tupleNestedMissing);
